# Prediction Market Agents

> Build and deploy AI trading agents for prediction markets

Prediction Market Agents lets you build, configure, and deploy AI trading agents that analyze prediction market questions on Kalshi and Polymarket. Each agent runs a structured debate between specialized AI roles: research analyst, forecaster, bull researcher, bear researcher, risk manager, and superforecaster — producing a consensus probability and automated trade decisions.

## Public Trade Analysis Pages
- URL pattern: https://www.example.com/t/{market-slug}
- Each page contains: AI consensus probability, entry price, exchange, full bull/bear debate, risk scores, key arguments and factors

## How It Works
1. AI agents independently research and analyze a prediction market question
2. Bull and bear researchers present opposing cases with key arguments
3. A superforecaster synthesizes all perspectives into a consensus probability
4. The system compares the AI consensus to market prices to find edges
